_meta.dataset: Official hours + published menu pricing evidence per MICHELIN restaurant
rules: Only values printed on the venue's own website are filled in.
Anything not published officially is left null and classed 'unverified'.
Per-person cost ranges are labelled: exact = printed on official site; unverified = not published.

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Official site posts temporary adjusted hours around holidays (e.g. '4:00 PM to 8:00 PM, Nov 19-21'); re-check the week of travel. Dress code: Business Formal. Children under 6 not permitted.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: unverified - the MGM Grand page shows menu dishes but no published tasting-menu price. Third-party reporting puts the degustation from ~$525/person (Matador Network) - NOT an official source, flagged.

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Official site: only two seatings nightly. Reservations up to three months in advance. Dress code: Upscale.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: unverified - no tasting-menu price published on the MGM/Cosmopolitan page. A 2023 YouTube review reports $290/person for the tasting menu - third-party, flagged.

hours.published: Official page displays an openings status widget ('Opens 5:00 PM'); a full 7-day table is not published on the page as retrieved.

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Dress code: Formal. Full week-by-week hours not published - UNVERIFIED, confirm by phone 702.731-7286.
restaurants.per_person_estimate_basis: 3-4 a-la-carte courses at the published prices above, before tax/tip. Tasting menu prices are on separate 'Prelude'/'Symphony' tabs that were not published as prices in the retrieved page.
restaurants.price_status: partial - a la carte exact; tasting menu unverified

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Official site posts temporary adjusted hours (e.g. 2:00 PM-8:00 PM, Nov 19-21). Dress code: Business Casual. Children 6 and under not permitted.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: unverified - no published menu price on the official MGM Grand page.

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Cocktail hour Mon-Thu 4:00-6:00 PM. Dress code casual. Reservations 877-893-2003. Rare for fine dining: open for lunch every day, from 10/11 AM.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: Bib Gourmand = good-value award; no per-person price published. Menu at chinapoblano.com/menus/.

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Lunch and brunch end at 3 PM, dinner restarts at 5 PM - the kitchen is closed 3-5 PM daily. Parties of 6+: $15 per person credit-card hold. 1131 S Main St (Arts District), 702-570-7864.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: Two seatings a day means lunch is materially cheaper than dinner, but no published per-person total.

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Official site (Google Sites) does not publish hours in text form; hours UNVERIFIED - flagged.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: No published pricing; menu is hosted on a third-party ordering platform.
restaurants.hours_unverified_reason: The restaurant's own site (yenvietkitchen.com, a Google Sites page) publishes NO hours. Directories agree on Mon & Wed-Sun 10AM-9PM, closed Tuesday, but the user's rule forbids using a third-party directory as a verified value, so hours stay blank.
restaurants.external_consensus_hours: Mon, Wed-Sun 10:00 AM - 9:00 PM; closed Tuesday (4 independent directories agree; not verifiable on an official page)

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Official site/social captions state DAILY 5:30 PM - 9:00 PM. Reservation-only; no walk-ins. Address 5040 Spring Mountain Rd.
restaurants.price_status: verified - exact prices on official menu PDF

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Brunch Sat & Sun 10:30 AM - 2:30 PM. Group dining 12+ call 702.607.3232.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: Large menu with Peking Duck priced per bird; no single published per-person menu price. unverified.

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Dress code business casual. Children under 5 not permitted. Located in Wynn Tower Suites.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: Official main menu is a PDF; per-person price not summarised on the page. unverified pending PDF read.

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Business casual required; tank tops, swimwear and open-toe shoes not permitted. Children must be 6+. No under-21 in restaurant or lounge after 10 PM. Open all seven days.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: No published per-person price; menu is an HTML page with no summary pricing.
restaurants.instagram_source: Linked from the official ARIA restaurant page

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Official Bellagio page states 'Monday to Sunday: Closed' plus seasonal closure dates (Nov 22-30; Dec 6-8, 13-15, 20-22). Temporarily closed at time of capture — re-check before booking for Feb 2027.
restaurants.per_person_estimate_basis: Exact figure published on the official Bellagio page: '$295++ Per Person', where ++ means tax and gratuity are additional.
restaurants.price_status: verified - exact price on official site
restaurants.operational_flag: Temporarily closed — the most important status on this page

hours.all_days: Dining room 5:00 PM - 10:00 PM; bar & lounge 4:00 PM - 10:00 PM

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Open daily. Thanksgiving Day hours differ (12:00-6:00 PM, 26 Nov 2026).
restaurants.price_status: partial - official menu PDFs published, price not extracted
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: Official tasting and a-la-carte PDFs are published but per-person totals were not extracted in this session.

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Brunch Thu 8 AM-1 PM, Fri-Sun 8 AM-2 PM. Note the official URL path is /dining/restaurants/bouchon.html - the /restaurants/bouchon.html path redirects. Thomas Keller bistro on the 10th floor, Venetian South Tower.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: French bistro; no published per-person total on the official page.

restaurants.hours_exceptions: CLOSED MONDAYS. Live music Fri & Sat 6-9 PM; reverse happy hour Fri-Sat 9-10 PM. The MICHELIN recognition applies to the Main Street location only - the 'SoulBelly Express' outlet at Miracle Mile Eats is a different counter.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: Texas BBQ; menu published but no per-person total quoted.
restaurants.instagram_source: Linked from the restaurant's own website footer

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Monday Pasta & Wine Night: two handmade pasta dishes plus a bottle of wine for $65 (not per person). Entire table must take the tasting menu if one person does. Cannot accommodate dairy-free, vegan, vegetarian, celiac, onion- or garlic-free diets. Off-Strip at 9205 W Russell Rd, Summerlin/Gramercy.
restaurants.per_person_estimate_basis: Official site prices the tasting menu at $85 per person. Tasting runs ~2-2.5 hours.
restaurants.price_status: verified - exact tasting price on official site

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Full bar (21+). Reservations are request-only and not confirmed until the restaurant replies. Casually priced - the cheapest MICHELIN-listed meal in this entire plan.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: Menu published with prices on a third-party ordering platform (fetail.com), not on the official site in text form.
restaurants.note: 24-hour service makes this the only MICHELIN venue in Las Vegas that can feed you after a late show.

restaurants.hours_unverified_reason: The official Venetian page renders a live 'Hours' widget that returned no schedule text to this fetch. The daily 'Butcher's Feast' set menu is confirmed to run daily, but exact opening and closing times were not captured.
restaurants.hours_exceptions: Butcher's Feast set menu daily - four cuts, banchan, guided grilling. Official page also lists 'One MICHELIN Star'.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: Set-menu price not published as text on the page fetched.

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Runs past midnight every night - one of the few MICHELIN-listed kitchens open after a late show. Use the Chinatown location: the Henderson branch is a separate room with its own wine list and was NOT the one recognised in the guide.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: Modern Thai; menu published, no per-person total quoted.

restaurants.hours_unverified_reason: The official site publishes its reservation widget but no plain-text hours section; the widget defaults to a date far from the travel window, so reading times off it would be a guess.
restaurants.hours_exceptions: Tasting menu only - 5, 7 or 9 courses. Cannot accommodate dairy-free, vegan, vegetarian, celiac, onion- or garlic-free diets (stated on the official site). Chef's Table is a 9-course menu with 9 wine pairings; a 12-seat private room exists.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: Menu structure confirmed (5/7/9 courses) but prices are not published on the site in text form.

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Unusually for a MICHELIN-listed room it serves lunch daily 11:30 AM-3 PM, with a cheaper 'Midday Menu' 3-5 PM before dinner starts at 5. That midday window is the best value on the Strip for this list.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: Market-price Greek seafood; no per-person total published. Midday menu pricing not captured.

restaurants.hours_exceptions: Open 17 hours a day, every day - dim sum at lunch, full Chinese menu late. Reservations suggested: 702-247-8136. Inside Gold Coast, which is also one of the cheaper hotels in this plan.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: Interactive menu with prices exists but no per-person total was extracted.

restaurants.hours_unverified_reason: The official site publishes opening hours only inside a dynamic widget that did not render in text form. Confirmed from the site itself: CLOSED Sunday and Monday, and happy hour runs Monday-Friday 5:00-6:30 PM. Exact closing time per night was not captured, so the full schedule is left unverified rather than assumed.
restaurants.hours_exceptions: Closed Sunday and Monday. Happy hour Mon-Fri 5:00-6:30 PM. Reservations require a credit card; cancellations inside 24 hours are charged $25 per guest. Maximum 4 guests per table without calling. Co-owner Chef Brian Howard trained under Thomas Keller.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: No per-person total published on the official site.

restaurants.hours_unverified_reason: The restaurant's official domain (kameomakase.com) redirects to sushikame.com, which renders a video-only homepage with no hours, days or price in text form. Nothing could be verified beyond the domain redirect, so all schedule and price fields are left blank.
restaurants.hours_exceptions: Unknown. Omakase-only format; typical for this style is a fixed-price chef's menu with two seatings, but that was NOT verified here and is deliberately not stated as fact.
restaurants.per_person_usd_note: Not published in text on any official page reachable from this environment.
